name: Enigma
notes: min_compute.yml miner block states gpu required: False, min_vram: 0, 'None required (CPU-only)'; 1 core / 8 GB RAM / 100 GB SSD. Validator side does need a 96 GB GPU (min_compute.yml:52-55). Plain python package (setup.py, requirements.txt, neurons/).

name: Chutes
notes: This clone is only the chutes CLI/SDK; README.md:5 points miner code to a separate repo (rayonlabs/chutes-miner). GraVal GPU attestation of miner-supplied GPUs (README.md:32-33), images must ship CUDA 12.2-12.6 (README.md:16). No VRAM floor stated for miners; README.md:165 min_vram_gb_per_gpu ge=16 is a chute deployment field, not a miner spec.

name: conjectures
notes: Zero GPU/CUDA/torch matches anywhere in the clone, but no explicit hardware requirements statement either, so gpu_required stays unknown. Validator-only repo (7 docker-compose files, Lean toolchain); miners use a separate conjectures-miner CLI. Miner economics are pay-per-attempt: 0.5 TAO per submission plus a ~20 GB / 30-60 min local verifier build (docs/MINER.md:39-41). Only 1 active miner.

name: Harnyx
notes: No GPU/CUDA/torch dependency anywhere in pyproject/docs and no hardware requirements section, so gpu_required is unknown rather than no. Miner writes a single agent.py against harnyx-miner-sdk and submits it; validators execute it in their own sandbox (miner/README.md:12-40). Setup is `uv sync --all-packages --dev` plus a .env with platform credentials. Real cost is LLM inference, not local hardware.

name: NOVA
notes: Miner doc benchmarks Boltz-2 affinity scoring at ~45s/molecule on an A100 (docs/MINER.md:190); README.md:13-15 requires CUDA 12.6 and 2 GPU devices for parallel inference. No explicit VRAM number stated. Vendored external_tools/boltzgen builds on nvidia/cuda:12.2.2 (external_tools/boltzgen/Dockerfile:3). Drug-discovery compute race; only 2 active miners.

name: NexisGen
notes: README System Requirements lists only yt-dlp/ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python 3.10-3.12, wallet files and Cloudflare R2 credentials (README.md:82-92) with no GPU. GPU appears only on the validator trainer path (docker/docker-compose.trainer.yml:31-33, nvidia, 8 GPUs). Miner runs `nexis mine`, builds a video clip dataset per 50-block interval and uploads to R2 -- needs a video source pipeline and paid object storage. prune_rank 1 is a red flag.

name: Gittensor
notes: min_compute.yml miner block is cpu: 2 / ram: 4 only, with no gpu section at all (min_compute.yml:11-13). No GPU/CUDA/torch matches anywhere in the clone. No miner neuron required: register a GitHub PAT via `gitt miner post` (README.md:41-50). Trivial to set up, but rewards depend on landing merged PRs in whitelisted repos, and burn_pct is 63%.

name: Phylax
notes: docs/miner_setup.md Requirements section lists only a Linux host for self-testing, btcli, an inference API key, and 50 alpha staked (docs/miner_setup.md:15-20) -- no GPU, and no GPU/CUDA/torch matches anywhere in the clone. Miner submits a single hash-pinned agent.py; validators run it in their own sandbox and no neuron is run (docs/miner_setup.md:7-10). Zero registration cost, but prune_rank 9.

name: Liquidity
notes: TypeScript/Bun + Hardhat repo (bun.lock, package.json, hardhat.config.js); no GPU/CUDA/torch matches and no hardware requirements section, so gpu_required is unknown. Repo is validator + voting scripts only; there is no miner neuron here -- mining is providing liquidity in voted pools, so the real cost is capital, not compute. Oldest clone in the batch (last commit 2026-06-24).

name: Vocence
notes: Miner sample deployment config pins gpu_count: 1 and min_vram_gb_per_gpu: 16 (miner_sample/example_repo/chute_config.yml:11-12), with device_preference: cuda (vocence_config.yaml:9) and torch/transformers/accelerate in the image build. The GPU is rented on Chutes rather than run locally -- miners host a TTS chute that validators call at /speak. Only 1 active miner. REWORKED: prune_rank null -> 'unknown' (upstream dereg.prune_rank is null because the subnet is inside its immunity window: dereg.is_immune true, risk_level 'immune', immunity ends 2026-08-12).
